name: Gästehaus Maximilian
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Maximilian is a traditional inn in Söll, Tirol. Its central location means the mountain railway is just a short walk away. The atmosphere in the house is quiet and friendly. Guests can expect accommodation with simple comforts. The surrounding area offers a wide range of leisure activities in summer and winter. Amenities include a restaurant and Wi-Fi.
